method: Exact links observed on primary project/download pages; no payload files downloaded or executed by the research agent.

sources.title: Script Hook V
sources.notes: Plain Node fetch reads the page successfully. Adding a generic Mozilla User-Agent together with a broad custom Accept header produced HTTP 406. HEAD on binary with Referer set to the project page returned application/zip, 200. Web text lookup redirects binary to the site root.

sources.title: Script Hook RDR2
sources.notes: HEAD on binary with Referer set to the project page returned application/zip, 200.

sources.title: Rampage Trainer
sources.notes: Both current variants expose public direct ZIP links on their download confirmation pages. Login/Register links are present but not required to obtain the direct URL.

sources.title: VisualV
sources.notes: Both current variants expose public direct 7z links on their download confirmation pages. Listing displays approximately 73.3 MB Enhanced and 196 MB Legacy.

sources.title: multiMAN MOD v4.91
sources.barrier: The public listing loads, but its observed Download endpoint returns HTTP 403 in web lookup and direct network requests. No actual binary URL retrieved.

sources.title: PKGi PS3 v1.3
sources.barrier: The public listing loads, but its observed Download endpoint returns HTTP 403. Its Developer Site link points to the GitHub release page, where v1.3.0 is listed.

sources.title: ControlConsole API 2.80 REV14
sources.notes: Public package endpoint responds HTTP 200 application/octet-stream with the stated attachment filename. Developer endpoint also serves application/octet-stream. No account required for the observed endpoints.

sources.title: WinAPIOverride
sources.notes: HTTP project page loads and exposes both links. HTTPS timed out in web lookup. HEAD requests to the observed HTTP ZIP URLs return 200 application/zip.

sources.title: PS4SX2 Emu 01.00 experimental alpha
sources.evidence: Exact asset link observed in https://github.com/Phoenixx1202/PS4SX2/releases/expanded_assets/01.00 ; HEAD returned 200 application/octet-stream.
sources.notes: Repository is present and the release is a pre-release. GitHub /releases/latest can return 404 when no non-prerelease exists; this does not indicate a removed repository. API currently returns 403 with x-ratelimit-remaining:0, so HTML release/expanded_assets inspection was used.

sources.title: RPCS3 port for PS4 v0.40 pre-release

downloads.title: RPCS3 port for PS4 v0.40 package

sources.evidence: Exact asset link observed in https://github.com/RoberixStudios/rpcs3-port-for-ps4/releases/expanded_assets/v0.40 ; HEAD returned 200 application/octet-stream.
sources.notes: Repository is present and the release is a pre-release. GitHub /releases/latest can return 404 when no non-prerelease exists. This is the specified third-party PS4 port, not the PC RPCS3 emulator. Package exceeds 100 MiB.

sources.title: PS5 RetroArch v4.0.0-beta-4
sources.evidence: Exact asset links observed in https://github.com/mihawk-99/PS5_RetroArch/releases/expanded_assets/v4.0.0-beta-4 ; archive HEAD returned 200 application/octet-stream.
sources.notes: The audit failure was a download timeout, not a removed asset. Archive is approximately 1.45 GiB and needs a long streaming download timeout. Release explicitly says games, BIOS files, firmware and keys are not included.

sources.title: Cheat Engine public binaries and GitHub 7.5 source
sources.evidence: GitHub 7.5 expanded_assets lists only source ZIP/tar.gz and no binary release assets. Official https://cheatengine.org/ and https://cheatengine.org/downloads.php link the exact CloudFront URL and identify it as the current public Windows 7.7 release.
sources.notes: Current GitHub API 403 responses are rate limiting (remaining:0), not repository removal. Do not label the 7.7 binary as 7.5. Official downloads page says the public installer includes optional software recommendations; the clean installer without those recommendations is Patreon-only. No Patreon-gated binary was obtained.

sources.title: shadPS4 0.21.0 Windows CLI emulator
sources.evidence: Official shadps4.net links github.com/shadps4-emu/shadPS4. Its latest stable release resolves to tag v.0.21.0; exact asset observed in expanded_assets/v.0.21.0 and HEAD returned200.
sources.notes: This archive contains the emulator executable without a GUI. Official downloads page distinguishes this from the separate Qt GUI launcher; label the actual CLI product. Do not substitute the daily prerelease.

sources.title: LOOT 0.29.2 Windows
sources.evidence: Official homepage Download LOOT links github.com/loot/loot/releases/latest, resolving to tag0.29.2. Exact Windows asset observed in expanded_assets/0.29.2; HEAD200.

sources.title: Vortex 2.9.0 Windows
sources.evidence: Original official page redirects to https://www.nexusmods.com/vortex . Its public Download for Windows button links https://api.nexusmods.com/vortex/download which redirects to this exact installer. HEAD200 application/x-msdos-program.
sources.notes: Public application installer, distinct from individual Nexus-hosted mods that require login. File exceeds100MiB.

sources.title: Wrye Bash 315 standalone Windows
sources.evidence: Official wrye-bash.github.io documentation links the wrye-bash/wrye-bash GitHub issue tracker, identifying the same project repository. Its latest stable release is v315. Exact standalone asset observed in expanded_assets/v315; HEAD200.
sources.notes: Public official GitHub alternative to the existing Nexus listing, without a Nexus login flow.

sources.title: System Informer 4.0.26241.138
sources.evidence: The existing official Process Hacker URL redirects to https://systeminformer.io/ . That site links github.com/winsiderss/systeminformer. Exact stable asset observed in expanded_assets/v4.0.26241.138; HEAD200.
sources.notes: Label this System Informer, the successor reached from the old project URL, not Process Hacker3.0.

sources.title: RetroArch 1.22.2 Windows x64
sources.evidence: Official https://www.retroarch.com/platforms.html lists stable1.22.2 and links this exact archive under Windows11/10/8.1/8/7 Download64bit. HEAD200 application/x-7z-compressed.
sources.notes: Windows application only, not a Lakka/Recalbox OS image. File exceeds100MiB. Existing card1.16.0 needs updating if this archive is linked.

sources.title: MSI Afterburner
sources.evidence: Official page labels the Final button4.6.6 and its linked main-2024.js shows the public token flow. Replicating that normal flow with the token concatenated raw returned200 application/zip,44244932bytes. Body was immediately canceled, not saved.
sources.notes: Do not encodeURIComponent the token; raw concatenation exactly matches the publisher script. No token values are stored in this map. MSI_VGA_Norton360_online.zip is a separate promotion and must not be treated as Afterburner.
